ticker: Iran warns of undersea cable threats
Andhra Pradesh issues cyclone red alert
Air India extends Saudi flight suspensions
Jordan church shooting leaves seven dead

articles.headline: Iran has detailed plans to hit Gulf undersea cables
articles.brief: Officials report that Iran has formulated detailed contingency plans to target critical Gulf undersea communication cables if regional warfare resumes.

articles.headline: Seven killed in Jordan church terrorist attack
articles.brief: Authorities in Jordan report that seven people were killed after gunmen opened fire at a church in what officials are calling a terrorist attack.

articles.headline: Andhra Pradesh braces for severe cyclonic storm
articles.brief: Weather experts issue a red alert for 13 districts in Andhra Pradesh as a very severe cyclonic storm approaches, with landfall expected between Bapatla and Vizag.

articles.headline: Violence flares during nationwide protests in France
articles.brief: Clashes erupt between protesters and police across major French cities during demonstrations over underfunded education and rising living costs, leading to widespread arrests.

articles.headline: Ukraine reports Starlink normal amidst US involvement
articles.brief: Ukraine states Starlink services have returned to normal following previous disruptions, as reports emerge detailing long-standing US government requests for network modifications.

articles.headline: American Express lifts profit forecast and slashes workforce
articles.brief: Financial services giant American Express raises its 2026 profit forecast while announcing a strategic plan to reduce its global workforce by five percent.

articles.headline: Air India and IndiGo extend Saudi flight suspensions
articles.brief: Major Indian carriers extend the suspension of flights to key Saudi Arabian destinations including Riyadh, Dammam, and Jeddah amid regional safety concerns.

articles.headline: UK advises citizens to maintain emergency household supplies
articles.brief: The United Kingdom government issues official guidance advising members of the public to keep at least three days of emergency supplies stored at home.

articles.headline: Hacking attempts surge as PHP vulnerabilities require patching
articles.brief: Cybersecurity firms report a sharp surge in automated hacking attempts as global corporations and governments race to patch critical PHP software flaws.

articles.headline: Pakistan faces severe LPG crisis as border trade halts
articles.brief: Pakistan's domestic energy crisis escalates as liquefied petroleum gas prices surge and hundreds of cargo trucks remain stranded at closed Iranian border crossings.

articles.headline: Ashoke Sen wins 2026 Oskar Klein Medal for physics
articles.brief: Renowned Indian physicist Ashoke Sen becomes the first Indian to receive the prestigious Oskar Klein Medal for his pioneering contributions to string theory and black-hole physics.

articles.headline: BJP criticizes Farooq Abdullah over Kashmir remarks
articles.brief: Bharatiya Janata Party leaders launch a fierce political attack against Farooq Abdullah, condemning his recent comments regarding Pakistan's role in protecting Kashmiris.

articles.headline: North Korean leader Kim crosses bridge into China
articles.brief: North Korean leader Kim Jong Un crosses a newly opened border bridge into China to meet officials as bilateral trade ties continue to strengthen.

articles.headline: Rahane omits Virat Kohli from all-time Test XI
articles.brief: Indian cricketer Ajinkya Rahane excludes star batter Virat Kohli from his personal selection of an all-time India Test cricket playing eleven.

articles.headline: Tagenarine praises father's guidance in cricket career
articles.brief: West Indian cricketer Tagenarine opens up about his professional development, highlighting the crucial mentorship and motivation provided by his father.
